### Peter, Servant of Jesus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/peter-servant-jesus
Passage: 2 Peter 1:1-2
Points:
- Early church acceptance and historical context support Peter's genuine authorship despite modern skepticism.
- Peter wrote near the end of his life to warn believers against false teachers distorting holiness and Christ's return.
- Believers receive spiritual standing on equal footing through the righteousness of Christ rather than personal merit.
- Christians should maintain doctrinal vigilance while exercising charity over nonessential disagreements.

### May Grace and Peace Be Multiplied to You
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/may-grace-and-peace-be-multiplied-to-you
Passage: 2 Peter 1:2
Points:
- Grace and peace are not merely static standings before God, but dynamic realities to be experienced daily.
- Our experience of peace and grace fluctuates, meaning believers always need fresh measures of both.
- God multiplies grace and peace through active means such as prayer, humility, and reading His Word.
- Growing in the true knowledge of God and Jesus Christ fuels the continual increase of divine grace.
